acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
guide_faults: The guide's rubric includes 'no content trapped behind sticky/fixed/overlay elements at any width', but the with-guide rationale table silently omits this axis entirely — no sticky header/footer/overlay is considered or ruled out as inapplicable, leaving it unclear whether it was checked or simply missed.
acceptance.verdict: Guide-assisted output hits ~10/11 rubric axes (respond-to() tokens, reflow-not-shrink, touch targets, chrome restraint, full-area states) versus the isolated baseline's ~8/11 — the baseline's biggest miss is exactly what the guide targets: hardcoded 768/1024/1440px breakpoints instead of project tokens.
